title: Incident-Replay Harness: Reproducing 2025 Agentic Incidents as Tests

original_idea.body: # Incident-Replay Harness: Reproducing 2025 Agentic Incidents as Tests

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: incident-replay regression tests are useful, but the catastrophic-risk link via case-study abstraction has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: abstract incidents into mock scenarios + replay harness; scenario design needs care.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (6-8 incident tests + replay scoring), abstraction adds some effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: mock sandboxes, no real systems, incident-response infra.

novelty.reasoning: Incidents are narrative; replay-harness pipeline may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: An incident-to-test replay library likely does not exist.
